description:
Telemetry-driven analysis (554 unthrottled renders → 269 throttle skips after wiring) revealed several structural issues in the rendering pipeline:

- `render_frame/1` in `Interactive` runs three sequential overlay compositing passes when at most one overlay is ever active
- `post_input_height/1` and `cursor_position/4` re-render sections already built by `render/2`, causing footer and dropdown to render up to three times per frame
- The internal composition function is named `render/2`, colliding with `Renderer.render/4` in the same calling context
- `force_next_render` is a boolean state flag that duplicates work already done by `Renderer`'s internal `needs_clear` flag
- `advance/1` calls a `maybe_suspend/1` no-op stub on every frame; `handle_call({:ui_request})` calls `render_frame` from two separate branches

Children are ordered by dependency — the layout metadata refactor (child 2) must land before the `force_next_render` removal (child 3) since both touch `render_frame/1`.
title: Simplify and streamline the TUI rendering pipeline
